subject: Big Data Analytics (BDA)
unit: Unit 5 - Big Data Visualization & Graph Analytics

questions.question: Illustrate the importance of Big Data visualization in analyzing large-scale datasets using a real-world application.
Relate the characteristics of Big Data—Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity, and Value—to the selection of suitable visualization techniques.
Examine the limitations of traditional visualization techniques when applied to Big Data.

topics.topic: Visualization Challenges - High Dimensionality, Unstructured & Missing Data

questions.question: Classify the major challenges of visualizing large-scale, high-dimensional datasets in Big Data Analytics.
Analyze the impact of high dimensionality on Big Data visualization and suggest suitable techniques to address it.
Analyze the challenges associated with visualizing unstructured data and recommend suitable visualization techniques.
Develop a strategy to visualize high-dimensional Big Data effectively while maintaining clarity, scalability, and interpretability.
Formulate a framework for handling missing data in Big Data visualization systems while preserving the reliability of analytical results.

topics.topic: Visual Data Analysis Techniques (Static vs Dynamic)

questions.question: Demonstrate the use of visual data analysis techniques to identify patterns and trends in a large retail dataset.
Compare different Visual Data Analysis Techniques used in Big Data applications.
Compare static and dynamic visualizations in Big Data applications.
Apply interaction techniques such as filtering, zooming, and drill-down to analyze a large-scale sales dashboard.
Assess the impact of different interaction techniques on user experience in Big Data visualization.
Design an interactive data visualization dashboard for real-time analytics, specifying appropriate charts, interaction techniques, and scalability requirements.
Illustrate the role of streaming visualization in handling large-scale live data.
Analyze the importance of scalability in Big Data visualization systems.
Examine the role of cloud computing in handling large-scale visualization tasks.
Evaluate the effectiveness of real-time data visualization techniques in analytics.

topics.topic: Graph Analytics - Fundamentals, Graph Types & Applications

questions.question: Illustrate how Graph Analytics identifies relationships among entities in a dataset.
List real-world applications of Graph Analytics.
Compare directed, undirected, and weighted graphs and assess their suitability for different Graph Analytics applications.
Analyze the impact of edge-weight variations on Graph Analytics outcomes.
Evaluate the impact of network topology on graph-based data analysis.

topics.topic: Graph Algorithms - Centrality, Community Detection, Clustering & ML

questions.question: Illustrate the application of degree centrality and betweenness centrality in Graph Analytics using a suitable network.
Analyze the role of machine learning in enhancing Graph Analytics techniques.
Compare different community detection algorithms used for analyzing large graph datasets.
Evaluate the trade-offs between computational efficiency and accuracy in graph clustering algorithms.

topics.topic: Graph Tools & Scalability - Neo4j, Apache Giraph, Distributed Processing

questions.question: Examine the role of graph databases such as Neo4j in analyzing large-scale graph data.
Assess the effectiveness of distributed graph processing frameworks such as Apache Giraph for large-scale graph analysis.
Formulate a method to improve scalability in graph-based visualization systems processing high-volume data.

topics.topic: Graph Analytics for Transactions, Fraud & Anomaly Detection

questions.question: Illustrate the application of graph analytics to identify relationships and suspicious patterns in transactional data.
Assess how transactional data patterns can be extracted using Graph Analytics.
Compare Graph Analytics applications in cybersecurity and healthcare, and recommend suitable graph-based methods for identifying anomalies in each domain.
Evaluate how Graph Analytics can improve the detection of anomalies in large graph datasets. Recommend suitable techniques and justify their applicability.

A financial institution wants to detect fraudulent transactions using Graph Analytics. Design a graph-based fraud detection approach and justify the selection of graph features and analytical techniques.
Propose an efficient Graph Analytics method for extracting patterns from large-scale transactional data. Justify the selection of graph representation and analytical algorithms.
